name: Ais Batu Campur
summary: A tall mountain of shaved ice in a melamine bowl, run through with red rose syrup and brown palm-sugar syrup and drizzled with evaporated milk, sweet corn and roasted peanuts on its crown; red beans, attap seeds and cubes of grass jelly and red and green jelly sit in the pink milk round its foot.
